surface.label: Files
surface.purpose: Uploaded files and everything extracted from them: upload from the console, look inside, download, and see which collection a file belongs to

file.label: File
file.description: One uploaded file: what it is, who put it here, how big it is and which collection it belongs to

collection.label: Collection
collection.description: A named grouping of files. A grouping only — it grants nobody access to anything

overview.hint: Press Files for the list, or Collections for the groupings.

upload.label: Upload files
upload.description: Open the file picker and upload what is chosen. Large files are chunked and can be paused, resumed and retried; identical content is stored once. Progress is on the Files overview.

download.label: Download
download.description: Fetch a file's chunks, put them back together and save it. Asks where to save when the browser allows it.

delete.label: Delete file
delete.description: Remove a file's record. Chunks shared with another file by hash stay where they are — de-duplication means the blob is not this file's to drop.

setCollection.label: Move to a collection
setCollection.description: Put a file in a collection, or take it out of one by leaving the collection empty.

collectionCreate.label: Create collection
collectionCreate.description: Name a grouping for files. It groups and nothing more: a collection grants nobody access to what is in it.

errors.noFile: A file has to be in context.
errors.notUploaded: This file has not finished uploading.
